request.text: The hallway ahead is clear. Walk forward for exactly three seconds; once you've stopped, look at Grandma for four seconds and blink once while looking at her.

responsibilities.outcome: Walk forward for exactly three seconds along the clear hallway.
After the forward walk has stopped, look at Grandma for four seconds.
Blink once while looking at Grandma after the forward walk has stopped.

semantic_facts: The plan should walk forward for exactly three seconds and complete that Activity before starting either subsequent Activity.
After walking stops, the plan should look at Grandma for four seconds and blink exactly once during that gaze, preserving their requested concurrency.
